definitions.explanation: Describes something magnificently beautiful with rich, vivid colors and elaborate ornamentation. Often used in formal or literary contexts for exceptional splendor.

examples.japanese: {絢爛|けんらん}⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧
{絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{衣装|いしょう}→衣装：14102_ishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧まとった。
{桃山|ももやま}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧だ。
examples.english: This castle conveys the brilliant culture of the Momoyama period.

notes:
Literary; usually {絢爛|けんらん}たる before a noun, less often {絢爛|けんらん}な. Used of rich color and elaborate ornament: art, architecture, festivals, the culture of a period.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絢爛|けんらん}⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧: gorgeous and lavish (a set phrase)
- {絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧: a brilliant culture
- {絢爛|けんらん}たる⟦{色彩|しきさい}→色彩：13956_shikisai⟧: dazzling colors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧: splendid — more common, also of skill and movement
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧: luxurious — about richness and expense
- ⟦{質素|しっそ}→質素：09201_shisso⟧: plain — the opposite
